name: Hexenzeit Appartements
beschreibung: The Hexenzeit Appartements in Söll are holiday apartments for two to four people. The location of the accommodation is central yet quiet. The village centre with shops and dining options is within walking distance. Each holiday apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, a separate bedroom, a living room and a bathroom. Free Wi-Fi and satellite TV are available. In winter, the slopes of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser – Brixental are directly accessible. In summer, the hiking trails start near the apartments. A parking space is available free of charge at the house.
